title: KNOW YE NOT

lines.text: Know ye not, know ye not, ye are a temple (3)
Ye are a temple of the Holy Ghost.
Full of praise, full of power,
Ye are a temple of the Holy Ghost.
Yes, I know, Yes I know, I'm the temple (3)
I am the temple of the Holy Ghost.
